identities.notes: Uses Apple's vendor ID. Matching needs the product name or protocol identity, not VID/PID alone.

evidence.source: UDB device report via WebHID: productName "Mechlands Vibe75"; interfaces FF68:0061 (no report IDs, 64 B in / 4096 B out) and FF13:0001 (no report IDs, 64 B in/out/feature)
evidence.hardware: Mechlands Vibe75, USB cable; Microsoft Edge 155 on Windows 11 (ROG Zephyrus G14 GA403)

use.purpose: Settings channel: 64-byte feature reports, report ID 0 (vendor driver uses HidD_SetFeature + IOCTL_HID_GET_FEATURE).

limitations: Command bytes recovered from the vendor driver statically; the driver itself never reads settings back.
Lighting read (04 12, then poll GET_FEATURE) works on the Vibe75; field meanings follow the XVX G75 layout.
The vendor driver ships a FirmwareUpdateTool. UDB never uses it.
